sloka: कर्णवन्ति हि भूतानि विशेषण तुरम्गमाः ।यूयम् तस्मान्निवर्तध्वम् याचनाम् प्रतिवेदिताः ॥२-४५-१५॥
transliteration: karṇavanti hi bhūtāni viśeṣaṇa turamgamāḥ ।yūyam tasmānnivartadhvam yācanām prativeditāḥ ॥2-45-15॥

translations.english: All animals, especially horses have a keen sense of hearing. Therefore, having listened to our entreaty, turn back.
